hero_kpi_rationale: E-commerce sales growth is Kroger's primary strategic driver, demonstrating its ability to adapt to evolving consumer behaviors and deliver double-digit growth (17% in 2025).

kpis.name: E-commerce Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in revenue generated from online sales, including deliveries and in-store pickups.
kpis.description: Indicates Kroger's ability to expand its presence and sales through digital platforms, a key segment for the future of retail.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth in the digital channel.

kpis.name: Total Sales
kpis.explanation: Total amount of goods and services sold during the fiscal period.
kpis.description: Represents the company's total business volume, including in-store and online sales.
kpis.signal: Modest but stable growth in overall sales.

kpis.name: Sales Excluding Fuel
kpis.explanation: Total sales minus fuel sales, providing a clearer view of core business activity.
kpis.description: Enables better assessment of the performance of food and other consumer goods sold by Kroger.

kpis.name: Identical Sales Excluding Fuel
kpis.explanation: Sales growth in stores open for at least one year, excluding fuel.
kpis.description: A key indicator of organic performance and customer loyalty in existing retail locations.
kpis.signal: Increased customer traffic in established stores.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Operating income before certain non-recurring or exceptional items.
kpis.description: Measures the company's operational performance by excluding items that could distort period-to-period comparisons.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Earnings Per Diluted Share
kpis.explanation: Net profit per share, adjusted for exceptional items.
kpis.description: A key financial performance indicator for investors, reflecting the company's ability to generate earnings per share.

kpis.name: Operating Profit from Alternative Revenue Streams
kpis.explanation: Profit contribution from activities other than food product sales, such as advertising or services.
kpis.description: Highlights growth in high-margin businesses like digital advertising (retail media), which complement the core business.
kpis.signal: Diversification of revenue and profit sources.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend paid to each shareholder.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's profit distribution policy and confidence in its ability to generate future cash flows.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Total amount of shares repurchased by the company in the market.
kpis.description: A capital return strategy to shareholders, reducing the number of shares outstanding and potentially increasing earnings per share.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Operating Profit from Alternative Revenue Streams
kpis.explanation: Contribution bénéficiaire des activités autres que la vente de produits alimentaires, comme la publicité ou les services.
kpis.description: Highlights growth in high-margin activities such as digital advertising (retail media), which complement core business operations.
kpis.signal: Diversification of revenue and profit sources.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company emphasizes customer data protection as a fundamental priority, with an integrated cyber risk management team within the CIS function led by the CDO and CISO.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, with competitors such as Albertsons, Costco, CVS Health, and other industry players.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations and food safety standards.
